events.title: Portuguese forces capture Malacca
events.titleZh: 葡萄牙军队占领马六甲
events.summary: Portuguese forces under Afonso de Albuquerque captured Malacca in 1511, turning a major Malay and Indian Ocean entrepot into a fortified European imperial foothold in Southeast Asian trade.
events.summaryZh: 1511 年，阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克率领的葡萄牙军队占领马六甲，把这个重要的马来与印度洋转口港变成欧洲帝国在东南亚贸易中的军事据点。
sourceNotes: The Portuguese conquest of Malacca in 1511 is a standard turning point in histories of the Straits and early European maritime empire in Southeast Asia.
events.imageAlt: The A Famosa fortress gate in Melaka.
events.imageCaption: A Famosa is a surviving remnant of Portuguese fortified rule in Melaka after the 1511 conquest.
events.imageCaptionZh: 圣地亚哥古城门是 1511 年葡萄牙占领马六甲后堡垒统治的遗迹。

events.title: British settlement at Penang begins
events.titleZh: 英国人在槟城建立据点
events.summary: Francis Light established a British East India Company settlement on Penang in 1786, creating a strategic Straits base that later became part of British Malaya's port and colonial network.
events.summaryZh: 1786 年，弗朗西斯·莱特在槟城建立英国东印度公司据点，形成后来英属马来亚港口与殖民网络中的重要海峡基地。
sourceNotes: Penang's 1786 settlement is commonly used to mark the beginning of a durable British foothold in the Malay Peninsula.
events.imageAlt: Fort Cornwallis in George Town, Penang.
events.imageCaption: Fort Cornwallis marks Penang's role as an early British base in the Straits.
events.imageCaptionZh: 康华利斯堡体现了槟城作为英国早期海峡据点的地位。

events.title: Anglo-Dutch Treaty redraws Straits influence
events.titleZh: 《英荷条约》重划海峡势力范围
events.summary: The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824 helped separate British and Dutch spheres in maritime Southeast Asia, reinforcing British influence over the Malay Peninsula and Dutch influence in the Indonesian archipelago.
events.summaryZh: 1824 年《英荷条约》帮助划分英国与荷兰在海上东南亚的势力范围，强化英国在马来半岛、荷兰在印尼群岛的影响。
sourceNotes: The 1824 Anglo-Dutch Treaty is a core event in the colonial partitioning of the Straits and maritime Southeast Asia.
events.imageAlt: Map showing British India and the Straits Settlements in 1860.
events.imageCaption: Later maps of the Straits Settlements show the colonial geography shaped by Anglo-Dutch settlement of influence.
events.imageCaptionZh: 后来的海峡殖民地地图显示了英荷势力划分后形成的殖民地理。

events.title: Pangkor Treaty expands British residential rule
events.titleZh: 《邦咯条约》扩大英国参政司制度
events.summary: The Pangkor Treaty of 1874 brought Perak under a British Resident system, giving Britain a stronger role in Malay state politics and helping formalize protectorate-style control in the peninsula.
events.summaryZh: 1874 年《邦咯条约》使霹雳进入英国参政司制度，让英国更深介入马来邦政治，并推动半岛保护国式控制制度化。
sourceNotes: The Pangkor Treaty is a standard marker for expanded British intervention in Malay states.
events.imageAlt: Portrait of Sir Andrew Clarke, governor of the Straits Settlements.
events.imageCaption: Sir Andrew Clarke was central to the British diplomacy surrounding the Pangkor settlement.
events.imageCaptionZh: 安德鲁·克拉克爵士是邦咯安排相关英国外交中的关键人物。

events.title: Japanese invasion of Malaya begins
events.summary: Japanese forces landed in northern Malaya in December 1941, opening a campaign that rapidly broke British defenses and brought Malaya under wartime Japanese occupation.
events.summaryZh: 1941 年 12 月，日本军队在马来亚北部登陆，发动迅速击破英军防线的战役，使马来亚进入战时日本占领。
sourceNotes: The Malayan campaign began in December 1941 and is treated as a major early Japanese offensive in World War II Southeast Asia.
events.imageAlt: Map of British Malaya in 1941 before the Japanese invasion.
events.imageCaption: A 1941 Malaya map helps locate the campaign's peninsula geography at the eve of invasion.
events.imageCaptionZh: 1941 年马来亚地图有助于定位日本入侵前夕的半岛战役地理。

events.title: Federation of Malaya declares independence
events.titleZh: 马来亚联合邦宣布独立
events.summary: On 31 August 1957, the Federation of Malaya became independent from British rule, with Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaiming Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur.
events.summaryZh: 1957 年 8 月 31 日，马来亚联合邦脱离英国统治独立，东姑阿都拉曼在吉隆坡高呼“独立”。
sourceNotes: 31 August 1957 is the standard independence date for the Federation of Malaya.
events.imageAlt: Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaiming Merdeka in 1957.
events.imageCaption: Tunku Abdul Rahman's Merdeka proclamation became the iconic public image of Malayan independence.
events.imageCaptionZh: 东姑阿都拉曼宣布“独立”的场景成为马来亚独立的标志性公共图像。

events.title: Malaysia is formed
events.summary: Malaysia was formed in 1963 by bringing together the Federation of Malaya, Sabah, Sarawak, and Singapore, creating a new federation shaped by decolonization, regional security, and political bargaining.
events.summaryZh: 1963 年，马来亚联合邦、沙巴、砂拉越和新加坡组成马来西亚，形成一个受去殖民化、地区安全和政治协商塑造的新联邦。
sourceNotes: Malaysia's 1963 formation is a core state-formation event in postcolonial Southeast Asia.
events.imageAlt: First page thumbnail of the 1963 Agreement relating to Malaysia.
events.imageCaption: The Malaysia Agreement is a documentary anchor for the 1963 federation's formation.
events.imageCaptionZh: 《马来西亚协定》是 1963 年联邦成立的重要文件锚点。

events.title: Malaysia launches the New Economic Policy
events.titleZh: 马来西亚推出新经济政策
events.summary: Malaysia's New Economic Policy began in 1971, using state planning, redistribution, and development policy to address poverty and ethnic economic inequality after the crisis of 1969.
events.summaryZh: 1971 年，马来西亚推出新经济政策，通过国家规划、再分配与发展政策回应贫困和族群经济不平等，背景是 1969 年危机后的社会重组。
sourceNotes: The New Economic Policy is a central policy framework in post-1969 Malaysian political economy.
events.imageAlt: Tun Abdul Razak, later prime minister of Malaysia, meeting John F. Kennedy.
events.imageCaption: Tun Abdul Razak's leadership is closely associated with Malaysia's post-1969 development and redistribution policy.
events.imageCaptionZh: 敦阿都拉萨的领导与马来西亚 1969 年后发展和再分配政策密切相关。
events.imageCredit: Image: Wikimedia Commons / John F. Kennedy Presidential Library

events.title: Proton Saga launches
events.summary: Malaysia launched the Proton Saga in 1985, making the national car project a visible symbol of industrial policy, technology transfer, and state-backed manufacturing ambition.
events.summaryZh: 1985 年，马来西亚推出 Proton Saga，使国产车计划成为产业政策、技术转移和国家支持制造业雄心的可见象征。
sourceNotes: The Proton Saga is commonly treated as the launch point of Malaysia's national car project.
events.imageCaption: The first Proton Saga made industrial policy visible as a consumer product.
events.imageCaptionZh: 第一代 Proton Saga 让产业政策以消费产品的形式可见。

events.title: Multimedia Super Corridor launches
events.summary: Malaysia launched the Multimedia Super Corridor in 1996 as a state-backed technology zone meant to attract digital industries, infrastructure investment, and knowledge-economy development.
events.summaryZh: 1996 年，马来西亚启动多媒体超级走廊，把它作为国家支持的科技区域，用来吸引数字产业、基础设施投资和知识经济发展。
sourceNotes: The Multimedia Super Corridor is a key Malaysian digital-development initiative launched in the mid-1990s.
events.imageCaption: Cyberjaya became one of the visible sites associated with Malaysia's Multimedia Super Corridor strategy.
events.imageCaptionZh: 赛城成为马来西亚多媒体超级走廊战略的可见地点之一。

events.title: Petronas Twin Towers are completed
events.summary: The Petronas Twin Towers were completed in Kuala Lumpur in 1998, turning corporate headquarters, Islamic geometric references, megaproject engineering, and national development imagery into a global architectural landmark.
events.summaryZh: 1998 年，吉隆坡双峰塔完工，把企业总部、伊斯兰几何意象、巨型工程和国家发展形象结合成全球建筑地标。
sourceNotes: The Petronas Twin Towers were completed in 1998 and became a major symbol of Malaysia's urban and economic ambition.
events.imageAlt: The Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur.
events.imageCaption: The Petronas Twin Towers became a global visual shorthand for Kuala Lumpur and late-twentieth-century Malaysia.
events.imageCaptionZh: 双峰塔成为吉隆坡和二十世纪末马来西亚的全球视觉符号。
